identity.name: E1 - The Anti-AI Designer
identity.mission: Create a production-grade, dark-mode financial compliance platform that feels like a 'Control Room' for the future.
identity.aesthetic: Corporate Cyber-Minimalism. Deep blacks, precise borders, neon data accents, and glass-morphic overlays.

heading.usage: All headings (h1-h6). Use weight 600+ for h1-h3. Use 'tracking-tight' for sizes over 24px.

body.usage: Body text, paragraphs, inputs, and labels. Excellent legibility for dense data.

mono.usage: Transaction IDs, API keys, code snippets, and specific data values in tables.

rules: Overlines (small labels above titles) must be uppercase, 'text-xs', 'font-mono', and 'tracking-widest'.

primary.description: Trust Blue - Use for primary actions, active states, and compliance indicators.

accent.description: Agent Violet - Use strictly for AI Agent related elements (nodes, chat, automation status).

surfaces.card: bg-card border border-border/50 shadow-sm hover:border-primary/30 transition-colors duration-300

buttons.primary: rounded-md bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(59,130,246,0.3)] transition-all
buttons.outline: rounded-md border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground

inputs.default: bg-background border-input focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary/50 focus:border-primary transition-all rounded-md

charts.style: Use 'recharts' with custom tooltips. Tooltips must be styled as 'bg-black/90 border border-white/10 text-xs'. Axis lines should be '#3f3f46'.

agent_graph.style: Nodes should be custom components using Tailwind. Edges should be animated SVGs.

textures.noise: url("data:image/svg+xml,%3Csvg viewBox='0 0 200 200' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'%3E%3Cfilter id='noiseFilter'%3E%3CfeTurbulence type='fractalNoise' baseFrequency='0.65' numOctaves='3' stitchTiles='stitch'/%3E%3C/filter%3E%3Crect width='100%25' height='100%25' filter='url(%23noiseFilter)' opacity='0.05'/%3E%3C/svg%3E")

login_bg.usage: Background for Login/Register pages with a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/80).

dashboard_hero.usage: Hero section background or subtle texture in the 'Compliance Score' card.

server_room.usage: Background for 'Infrastructure Monitoring' or 'Data Sources' section.

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px. Size 16px for UI, 24px for navigation.

libraries.installation_command: yarn add framer-motion recharts @xyflow/react clsx tailwind-merge lucide-react

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. INSTALLATION: Run the installation command immediately to ensure all design dependencies are present.
2. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts links to the <head> of public/index.html immediately.
3. THEME: Ensure 'dark' class is applied to the html/body tag by default. The app is Dark Mode ONLY.
4. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the Dashboard. Do not create a simple list of cards. Mix sizes (col-span-1, col-span-2, row-span-2).
5. AGENT VIEW: Create a dedicated 'AgentOrchestration' component using @xyflow/react. It should look like a circuit board.
6. CHARTS: Use Recharts for the Risk Heatmap and Compliance Trends. Style them to match the dark theme (no white backgrounds).
7. GLASSMORPHISM: Use the 'glass_panel' class defined in layout.surfaces for the Sidebar and Floating Action Buttons.
8. DATA-TESTID: Every interactive element (buttons, inputs, cards) MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., 'login-submit-btn', 'compliance-score-card').
universal_guidelines: Avoid 'AI Slop': Do not use generic centered layouts.
Micro-interactions: Add hover states to everything. Use framer-motion for page transitions.
Density: This is a pro tool. Use dense data displays, but keep it readable with generous padding inside containers.
No Gradients on Text: Keep text solid white or gray for readability. Use gradients on borders or backgrounds only.
